reason: I already have a LARQ I'm happy enough with, and nothing here tells me what this filter actually removes. A creator pitch plus 'supplier rated 150 L' isn't enough to make me switch and sign up for another subscription.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? There's no independent test or certification shown, just a supplier rating, and my problem is forgetting my bottle, not the bottle I own.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results or an NSF certification showing exactly what the filter removes, plus a no-questions return if I don't like it.
